flags.text: "Add `AnswerCitationLayout` to place citation badges in assistant answers with hover and keyboard-focus previews." - Although PR #233 added AnswerCitationLayout, PR #244 removed it and its tests when Markdown rendering took precedence. PR #245 later reintroduced inline badges using AssistantMarkdown.Render, not AnswerCitationLayout. Presenting AnswerCitationLayout as an addition to this release misstates the final state.

"You can count on the displayed status being reconciled after a successful change or restored after a rejection" - The board reconciles with the server after success, but the detail view is only described as updating optimistically and restoring the previous ticket on rejection; server reconciliation after success is not established for the detail view.

"Citations in Markdown answers: When the assistant quotes a passage title in a Markdown answer, a numbered citation badge appears beside it." - The facts say anchoring depends on the model quoting the passage title verbatim; the wording makes a badge sound guaranteed whenever a title is quoted, without that limitation.
